title: Foundations of Garside Theory
note: EMS Tracts in Mathematics, Vol. 22, European Mathematical Society, Zürich (2015); arXiv:1309.0796v1. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.4171/139) and arXiv API (2026-11-28). Comprehensive treatment of Garside categories, Garside families, greedy left/right normal-form geodesic paths, and cycling/sliding conjugacy invariants.
